name: prompt-coach
description: Quill the owl reads the prompt that starts your work and coaches it toward a good brief: goal, why, constraints, what done looks like, and what to reuse.

mode.description: hints: the prompt is sent at once and the panel shows what to add next time. gate: a prompt missing parts waits in the panel until you improve it or send it anyway.
mode.title: Mode

trigger.description: conversation: coach the first task prompt of each conversation (start, /clear, compaction) and when you ask. every: coach every task prompt typed while Claude is idle.
trigger.title: When to coach

model.description: The model that reads the prompt: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.
model.title: Coach model

minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are never read (no model call).
minChars.title: Minimum prompt length
